## MCP Read-Only Tools (`atruss mcp`)

- `list_repositories`, `get_repo_architecture`, `get_pipeline_dag`, `find_cross_repo_impacts`, `get_blast_radius`, `trace_entrypoint_chain`, `get_security_findings`, `query_antipatterns`, `get_repo_scorecard`, `check_boundary_violation`
